build_anli_dataset: build the ANLI dataset by downloading and extracting data to the specified datapath
run_build_function: run the build function to download ANLI v0.1 data into the ParlAI datapath directory
check_anli_version: check if the ANLI dataset is already built for version v0.1 in the datapath
download_anli_resources: download the ANLI v0.1 zip file from the FAIR public files server
review_build_function: review the build function that handles ANLI dataset download and version management
